description: This is a test suite for the litellm library, specifically for testing various functionalities of language model interactions, including streaming, prompt caching, tool invocation, response formats, and more. It contains multiple test classes and methods to validate correct behavior and integration of models under different conditions.

classes.name: BaseLLMChatTest
